notes: ACCESS: same curl_cffi Chrome-impersonation Session (tier 1 HTTP only; no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow; never needed Playwright/CDP or Claude-in-Chrome). SCOPE: Home & Kitchen / Furniture / Home Decor departments only. WHAT WAS CHECKED: (1) direct URL guess /new-arrivals - 404. (2) sitemap_s_store-browse.xml.gz and sitemap_t_tag-browse.xml.gz grepped for new-arriv/newarriv/just-in/latest-arriv/new-in/whats-new - zero matches anywhere in scope. (3) Main nav and footer of homepage + /furniture, /home-decor, /home-kitchen main pages - no dedicated New Arrivals nav/footer link. (4) Sort options on category PLPs (all three departments) include a 'Newest First' button - this is a re-sort of the SAME category listing (identical product set/URL base, just re-ordered), not a distinct listing with its own identity or count; excluded per brief as a sort/filter, not a genuine separate PLP. (5) SIGNIFICANT CANDIDATE investigated and EXCLUDED: the Home Decor department page (/home-decor/pr?sid=arb) exposes a 'New Arrivals' checkbox facet inside its FILTERS widget (facet id 'new_arrival', title literally 'New Arrivals', initial sidebar count=3036) - this IS an exact target-term match, but structurally it is implemented identically to the page's other filter facets (price range, discount range, brand, 'Offers') as one more checkbox in the same scrollableView list, not as a separate URL path, nav entry, or page title - the page itself remains titled/H1'd 'Home Decor' regardless. Attempted to apply the facet directly via URL query param (several encodings of p[]=facets.new_arrival[]=New+Arrivals) and repeat-fetched: the sidebar echoed 'selected':true and its own count dropped from 3036 to 1362, but the rendered product-count header did NOT converge on either figure (15,174 unfiltered vs 10,483 then 10,734 on two 'filtered' fetches of the identical URL) - i.e. the HTTP-tier fetch could not reliably produce a properly filtered, countable listing, consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's documented finding that this site's facetResponse counts are volatile/unreliable on repeat fetches. Separately, flipkart.com/robots.txt carries a site-wide 'User-agent: *' rule 'Disallow: *=facets*' (and 'Disallow: *sort=*') - i.e. the site's own robots policy treats any facet- or sort-parameterized URL as a non-canonical filter view rather than an indexable page, corroborating that this is a filter, not a standalone New Arrivals PLP. This facet was NOT found on the Furniture (sid=wwe) or Home & Kitchen (sid=j9e) department pages - only on Home Decor (sid=arb). On balance this was treated as the brief's excluded 'arbitrary date-filter' case (a checkbox that filters by recently-added status, same mechanism as every other facet on the page) rather than a genuine separate PLP; recorded here in full so a reviewer can override if they weigh the exact-term-name match more heavily than the structural filter evidence. (6) Site search 'new arrivals home decor' -> generic cross-category keyword search results page (title contains 'All Categories'), excluded as a search-results page. CONCLUSION: no genuine nav-exposed New Arrivals PLP exists for Home & Kitchen/Furniture/Home Decor on Flipkart; the closest candidate (the Home Decor 'new_arrival' filter facet) was investigated in depth and excluded as a filter, not a listing, per above.
